description: Replace the organisations of a person. Required: contact_id, links [{ account_id, function?, is_primary? }]. Exactly one link may be is_primary; if none is marked, the first becomes the main organisation. The main organisation is also written to the contact (account_id). links=[] removes all.

links.description: Organisations of the person: [{ account_id, function?, is_primary? }]; [] removes all

function.description: The person's function or job title in this organisation

is_primary.description: Marks this organisation as the person's main organisation (at most one)

name: set_contact_accounts
